name: Greek Mediterranean Pizza
instructions: Stretch it to fit the pan , creating as thick or thin a crust as you wish
Place pizza dough in greased dish / baking tray with a little bit of cornmeal sprinkled on the bottom
Spread hummus onto the dough in the pan
Fry chicken in a pan with a little bit of oil , italian seasoning , and salt
Once the chicken is cooked through , place evenly over pizza
Spread red pepper and red onion evenly over pizza
Bake in a 350 degree oven for 10-13 minutes or until crust is golden brown on sides and bottom
